name: SA:GE V3.1.0
releaseNotes:
### SA:GE V3.1.0

SA:GE V3.1.0 delivers a unified website-inspired design system, comprehensive visual hierarchy polish in the Event Studio, and improved XAML parser stability.

#### What's New in V3.1.0
* **Unified Website-Inspired Design System**: Deep charcoal background (#0A0F14), navy slate workspace surfaces (#16202E), refined hairline borders (#233246), mint (#00C58E) & cyan (#06B6D4) accent palette, and consistent 6px/8px control geometry across all studios.
* **Event Studio Polish & Usability**: Refined action cards with immutable layout geometry, Scene Overview & Live Cast inspector, streamlined End Event command routing, and real-time tile coordinate status indicator.
* **Theme & Accent Customization**: Multi-theme support with instant live switching between Dark, Light, and System Default, alongside user-selectable accent palettes (Emerald Mint, Electric Cyan, Royal Amber, Amethyst).
* **Parser Stability & Bug Fixes**: Resolved XAML markup extension collisions and compilation warnings in Event Studio coordinate status panels.
